description: Provenance re-run, corrected: contact-residue scoring of ADNP2 and ADNP against 238 reviewed human homeodomains, with the 0/6 outlier set, named controls, InterPro signatures and QuickGO annotation provenance
code:
# =====================================================================
# PROVENANCE SCRIPT: kgap-adnp2-homeodomain-dna-recognition
# Headline numbers for final_report.md. Live data from UniProt REST,
# InterPro API and QuickGO. Background excludes ADNP2 and ADNP.
# =====================================================================
import requests, numpy as np
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
def fa(a):
    return "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.fasta" % a,
                                timeout=60, headers=H).text.split("\n")[1:])

ANTP = "RKRGRQTYTRYQTLELEKEFHFNRYLTRRRRIEIAHALCLTERQIKIWFQNRRMKWKKEN"   # P02833, canonical 1-60
S2, S1 = fa("Q6IQ32"), fa("Q9H2P0")
HD2, HD1 = S2[1042:1102], S1[755:815]
print("ADNP2 HD 1043-1102:", HD2)
print("ADNP  HD  756-815 :", HD1)

q = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00046+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=500&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_dna_bind,sequence")
j = requests.get(q, timeout=120, headers=H).json()
bg = []
for e in j["results"]:
    seq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    g = e.get("genes", [{}])[0].get("geneName", {}).get("value", e["primaryAccession"])
    for ft in e.get("features", []):
        if ft["type"] == "DNA binding" and "homeobox" in (ft.get("description") or "").lower():
            s, t = ft["location"]["start"]["value"], ft["location"]["end"]["value"]
            if s and t and 60 <= t - s + 1 <= 70:
                bg.append((e["primaryAccession"], g, seq[s-1:s+59]))
print("reviewed human PF00046 entries: %d | ADNP2 present: %s | ADNP present: %s"
      % (len(j["results"]), "Q6IQ32" in [b[0] for b in bg], "Q9H2P0" in [b[0] for b in bg]))
bg = [b for b in bg if b[0] not in ("Q6IQ32", "Q9H2P0")]
N = len(bg)

cols  = [Counter(h[i] for _, _, h in bg) for i in range(60)]
cons  = "".join(c.most_common(1)[0][0] for c in cols)
consf = [c.most_common(1)[0][1] / N for c in cols]
print("consensus (n=%d): %s" % (N, cons))

BASE  = [3, 5, 47, 50, 51, 54]
BBONE = [25, 28, 31, 53, 55, 57]
CORE  = [16, 20, 38, 40, 45, 48, 49]
print("\npos role      Antp cons  freq   ADNP ADNP2 match")
for p in sorted(BASE + BBONE + CORE):
    r = "base" if p in BASE else ("backbone" if p in BBONE else "core")
    print("%3d %-9s %s    %s    %.3f  %s    %s     %s" % (p, r, ANTP[p-1], cons[p-1], consf[p-1],
                                                          HD1[p-1], HD2[p-1], HD2[p-1] == cons[p-1]))
print("\nhelix 3, positions 48-53   consensus %s | ADNP %s | ADNP2 %s" % (cons[47:53], HD1[47:53], HD2[47:53]))

def nm(h): return sum(h[p-1] == cons[p-1] for p in BASE)
bgm = np.array([nm(h) for _, _, h in bg])
print("\nbase-contact consensus matches (of 6): ADNP2 %d | ADNP %d | background %.2f +/- %.2f"
      % (nm(HD2), nm(HD1), bgm.mean(), bgm.std(ddof=1)))

BGF = {'A':.0788,'R':.0553,'N':.0419,'D':.0536,'C':.0193,'Q':.0393,'E':.0638,'G':.0707,
       'H':.0227,'I':.0591,'L':.0963,'K':.0595,'M':.0238,'F':.0397,'P':.0469,'S':.0683,
       'T':.0542,'W':.0121,'Y':.0303,'V':.0675}
a0 = 5.0
PC = {p: {a: np.log2(((cols[p-1].get(a, 0) + a0*BGF[a]) / (N + a0)) / BGF[a]) for a in BGF}
      for p in sorted(BASE + BBONE)}
def cs(h): return sum(PC[p].get(h[p-1], -4.0) for p in sorted(BASE + BBONE))
bgs = np.array([cs(h) for _, _, h in bg])
mu, sd = bgs.mean(), bgs.std(ddof=1)
v2, v1 = cs(HD2), cs(HD1)
print("\nDNA-reading-surface log-odds (12 contact positions), background %.1f +/- %.1f (n=%d)" % (mu, sd, N))
print("  ADNP2 %.1f  z %.2f  percentile %.1f" % (v2, (v2-mu)/sd, 100*(bgs < v2).mean()))
print("  ADNP  %.1f  z %.2f  percentile %.1f" % (v1, (v1-mu)/sd, 100*(bgs < v1).mean()))

print("\nbackground proteins with 0/6 base-contact matches, with their contact scores:")
for (a, g, h) in sorted(bg, key=lambda b: cs(b[2])):
    if nm(h) == 0:
        print("   %-9s %-8s matches 0/6  contact score %6.1f  percentile %5.1f" % (g, a, cs(h), 100*(bgs < cs(h)).mean()))

print("\nnamed controls:")
for g0 in ["PITX2", "EN2", "HOXB13", "CUX1", "ZEB1", "POU4F1", "ZHX1", "NANOG"]:
    for (a, g, h) in bg:
        if g == g0:
            print("   %-8s %-8s %d/6  contact score %6.1f  percentile %5.1f  helix3 48-53 %s"
                  % (g, a, nm(h), cs(h), 100*(bgs < cs(h)).mean(), h[47:53]))
            break

def chg(h): return h.count('K') + h.count('R') + 0.1*h.count('H') - h.count('D') - h.count('E')
bgc = np.array([chg(h) for _, _, h in bg])
print("\nnet charge: ADNP2 %+.1f (percentile %.0f) | ADNP %+.1f | background %.1f +/- %.1f"
      % (chg(HD2), 100*(bgc < chg(HD2)).mean(), chg(HD1), bgc.mean(), bgc.std(ddof=1)))

for acc, nmz in [("Q6IQ32", "ADNP2"), ("Q9H2P0", "ADNP")]:
    r = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/entry/all/protein/uniprot/%s/?page_size=200" % acc,
                     timeout=120, headers=H).json()
    hits = set()
    for e in r.get("results", []):
        md = e["metadata"]; db = md.get("source_database")
        if db in ("pfam", "prosite", "profile", "smart", "cdd", "ssf", "cathgene3d"):
            for pr in e.get("proteins", []):
                for ent in pr.get("entry_protein_locations", []):
                    for f in ent["fragments"]:
                        if f["start"] > 1000 or (acc == "Q9H2P0" and f["start"] > 700):
                            hits.add((db, md["accession"], f["start"], f["end"]))
    print("\n%s (%s) signatures over the homeodomain region:" % (nmz, acc))
    for h in sorted(hits): print("    %-10s %-16s %4d-%4d" % h)

r = requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search",
                 params={"geneProductId": "UniProtKB:Q6IQ32", "limit": 100},
                 headers={**H, "Accept": "application/json"}, timeout=120).json()
print("\nQuickGO annotations for UniProtKB:Q6IQ32 (%d rows)" % r.get("numberOfHits", 0))
seen = set()
for a in r.get("results", []):
    k = (str(a.get("goId")), str(a.get("goName"))[:44], str(a.get("goEvidence")),
         str(a.get("evidenceCode")), str(a.get("reference")), str(a.get("assignedBy")))
    if k in seen: continue
    seen.add(k)
    print("   %-11s %-44s %-4s %-16s %-24s %s" % k)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4))
ax[0].hist(bgs, bins=28, color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(v2, color="#d1495b", lw=2.5); ax[0].axvline(v1, color="#2a9d8f", lw=2.5)
ax[0].annotate("ADNP2 %.1f" % v2, (v2, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.90), color="#d1495b", fontsize=10)
ax[0].annotate("ADNP %.1f" % v1, (v1, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.74), color="#2a9d8f", fontsize=10)
ax[0].set_xlabel("DNA-reading-surface log-odds (12 contact positions)")
ax[0].set_ylabel("human homeodomains (n=%d)" % N)
ax[0].set_title("Contact-surface score")
vals, cnts = np.unique(bgm, return_counts=True)
ax[1].bar(vals, cnts, color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white")
ax[1].bar([0], [cnts[list(vals).index(0)]], color="#d1495b")
ax[1].set_xlabel("base-contact positions matching consensus (of 6)")
ax[1].set_ylabel("human homeodomains")
ax[1].set_title("ADNP2 %d/6, ADNP %d/6, background mean %.2f" % (nm(HD2), nm(HD1), bgm.mean()))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
